article.title: Forms of certificate and extended certificate.
article.content:
377Forms of certificate and extended certificate.

Section 377  ·  Part X  ·  page 93 of the Act
Certificates shall be granted and extensions of certificates shall be made, as nearly as circumstances admit, in the forms set forth in Schedule VIII.
